messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — planning to pin polaris-2b-v1 (quant8) to catalog slot #42 tonight. Target window 23:00-23:30 PST. Looking for: who will kick off the deploy, who owns smoke checks, and who’s on rollback duty? @Devon @Samir
Devon Patel: I can trigger the deploy ~23:05. Can someone confirm canary traffic % and instance count for the canary pods? Also, which cluster (staging vs prod-1) are we using for the first pass?
Samir Rao: Canary = 10% for first 5m, then 50% for 10m if metrics look stable. I'll run the smoke checklist and monitor error rates & p90 latency. Using prod-1 cluster for canary.
Elena G.: I’ll own rollback and observability. If 5xx spike >5% sustained for 2m or p95 jumps >1s, we rollback. I’ll watch #eng-oncall and traces. Add me to any incident if we flip.
Maria Chen: Quick smoke checklist for reference (will paste into PR as well):
- sanity generation (basic prompt)
- latency & error-rate watch for canary nodes
- sample QA prompts from eval set (small subset)
- verify pin metadata written to catalog after deploy

Samir Rao: Smoke commands I’ll run:
```
# basic generation
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/models/polaris-2b-v1:generate -d '{"input":"hello world"}' | jq .

# check k8s rollout
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/polaris-2b-canary

# tail relevant logs for 10m
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=polaris-2b -f --since=10m
```
Devon Patel: Note: catalog pin metadata should be set as `catalog.pin=polaris-2b-v1@2026.03.17`. I opened PR #4587 to add the pin and the rollout notes. PTAL @Elena for manifest healthcheck comment.
Elena G.: Reviewing PR now. One quick change: add readinessProbe to canary deployment (GET /healthz) and a short initialDelaySeconds=10 so probes don’t flake during startup. Also please include resource limits for canary pods.
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued -> job-id abcd-1234. Scheduled start: 2026-03-17T23:05:00-08:00 (23:05 PST).
Maria Chen: Thanks — plan: Devon triggers at ~23:05, Samir runs smoke checklist, Elena watches rollback & traces. If canary looks good we promote to slot #42 dedicated at ~23:40. If rollback required: revert catalog pin, scale back canary, open incident and tag @oncall. I’ll update here after each step.
Devon Patel: Ack :thumbsup: I’ll post the deploy job link once I start.
Samir Rao: Will post smoke metrics (error%, p95, sample outputs) 10m after canary start.
Elena G.: I’ll stay around until 00:15 PST to confirm promote/rollback decision.
Maria Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone.
